name: Myself;Yourself: Sorezore no Finale
source:
The game features four new scenarios with Nanaka and Asami getting separate scenarios, and there are two duel scenarios with Syuri and Aoi in one, and Hinako and Yuzuki in the other. Several new characters are also introduced.

[from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Myself_;_Yourself]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
本作包含四篇新故事：菜菜香和麻绪美各自拥有独立篇章；另有两篇双人故事，一篇由修里和葵共同登场，另一篇则属于雏子和柚希。游戏还加入了数名新角色。

[摘自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Myself_;_Yourself]Wikipedia[/url]]
